_comment: 森林章节剧本。主线 = 剧情姐新稿 forest_v2.txt（第四版）+ 10-29 对白表修订 + 10-29 合订稿 yun1.txt（第六版：通讯器暗线，phone_* 步骤见 docs/phone_and_cockpit_contract.md），第三版自由度（A 道具、B 三样东西、C 姓名牌、glade、D 岩画）叠加。格式见 docs/forest_chapter.md。开场：坠毁动画播完、晨爬起来以后播 scene "intro"。markers 里 room_* 是相对树屋锚点的 x（和 art/forest_story/treehouse.json 的 hotspots 一致）。带 "added": true 的是补写的（不是剧情姐原句），游戏里显示成蓝色给她审。hints：玩家 20 秒没推进主线时，按当前 flag 取第一个满足条件的条目，随机说一句。

objectives.en: Head out, back to the ship
Find the backpack, and your memory
Head out, back to the ship
Find a spring and a valve
Find sap, a spring, a valve
Find someone who can fix it

lines.en: The deer's waiting on the slope.
Sap... which tree is leaking sap?
The deer by the door might know.

lines.zh: 空屋的窗台上，好像有个闹钟。
lines.en: I think there's a clock on the empty house's windowsill.
The deer by the door might know.
That signal box in the clearing...
Maybe the valve's still on it.

lines.zh: 木板也许能搭在塌陷口上。
lines.en: A plank might reach across the sinkhole.

lines.zh: 阀门……塌陷口那边过不去。
lines.en: The valve... but I can't get past the sinkhole.

lines.zh: 小吃棚的架子好像塌了。
lines.en: The snack stall's shelves looked collapsed.
That knocking... which way is it coming from?
...Stay away from where the water's loudest.

lines.zh: 底下那两根树枝，先拖开。
lines.en: Drag those two branches out first.

lines.zh: 前面好像被什么挡住了。

lines.en: The deer's going so slowly... waiting for me?
The old road's to the right.

lines.zh: 附近应该还有能烧的东西。
lines.en: There should be more to burn around here.

lines.zh: 左边好像有什么在反光。
lines.en: Something's glinting off to the left.

residents._note: 10-31 大嘴鸟（美术组的图）：林间空地尽头、信号箱右边倒木前，可去可不去

toucan._note: 10-31 以物易物（scripts/barter.gd），作者按 docs/以物易物交换表.md 定稿。flag：barter_toucan_<id>；终章、飞行一看这些 flag。

toucan_hello.zh: 哎哎，别走那么快！这块空地好久没来过会走路的了。
toucan_hello.en: Hey, hey, not so fast! Nothing that walks has come through this clearing in ages.

toucan_hello.zh: 我嘛，在这儿收东西。亮的、圆的、会响的，什么都收。
toucan_hello.en: Me? I collect things here. Shiny ones, round ones, ones that jingle. I take them all.

toucan_hello.zh: 摆着看呀。东西放久了，就会想起自己是从哪儿来的。
toucan_hello.en: To look at, of course. Leave a thing long enough and it remembers where it came from.

toucan_hello.zh: 你身上叮叮当当的。拿出来看看？我也有好东西换给你。
toucan_hello.en: You're jingling all over. Let's have a look? I've got good stuff to trade, too.

toucan_again.zh: 又是你！今天带亮的来了没有？
toucan_again.en: You again! Brought anything shiny today?

toucan_wrong.zh: 嗯……这个不够亮。你自己留着吧。
toucan_wrong.en: Hmm... not shiny enough. You hang on to it.

toucan_none.zh: 不换也行。我又不走，这截树桩也不走。
toucan_none.en: No trade? Fine. I'm not going anywhere. Neither is this stump.

toucan_react_drawing.zh: 这张不行。你拿着它的样子，一看就是不能换的。
toucan_react_drawing.en: Not that one. The way you're holding it, I can tell it's not for trading.

toucan_take_scrap.zh: 这个！边上还烫着，亮得像刚掉下来的星星。
toucan_take_scrap.en: This one! The edge is still warm. Shiny as a star that just fell.

toucan_take_scrap.zh: 拿我最好的一根尾羽换。别嫌弃，它比你那块铁轻多了。
toucan_take_scrap.en: I'll trade you my best tail feather. Don't turn your nose up, it's a lot lighter than your bit of iron.

toucan_hear_musicbox.en: ...So you wait a little where the tune turns.

toucan_hear_musicbox.zh: 我学会了。拿着，空心枝子削的，吹出来就是刚才那一句。
toucan_hear_musicbox.en: Got it. Here, I whittled it from a hollow twig. Blow it and you'll hear that same phrase.

toucan_take_stone.zh: 蓝的！你知道它只有湿的时候才亮吧？
toucan_take_stone.en: Blue! You know it only shines when it's wet, right?

toucan_take_stone.zh: 那换这个。河里冲圆的玻璃，干着也亮。你就不用一直弄湿它了。
toucan_take_stone.en: Then take this instead. Glass the river wore round. Shines even when dry. You won't have to keep wetting it.

toucan_done.zh: 我的好东西都在你那儿啦。路过就回来给我看看。
toucan_done.en: All my good stuff's with you now. Come show me when you pass by.

intro.zh: 啊……糟糕。早知道就买保险了。
行，你先歇着，我还没打算让你报废呢
intro.en: Fine, you rest. I'm not scrapping you yet.
...Is that the one you told me about?

intro.zh: 偏偏这时候坏，你可真会挑。
intro.en: Breaking down now, of all times. Great timing.

intro.zh: 我一定要找到大象，因为
intro.en: I have to find the elephant, because

intro.zh: 如果有一天我们不联系了，你就去找云层里的大象，找到它，就能再次收到我的消息。
intro.en: If we ever stop talking, go find the elephant in the clouds. Find it, and you'll hear from me again.

intro.zh: 我问为什么，她说到时候就知道了。我问我们为什么会不联系，她笑了一下。
intro.en: I asked why. She said I'd know when the time came. I asked why we'd ever stop talking. She just smiled.

treeline_gap.zh: 那道缺口的弧，和画上一样。
treeline_gap.en: The curve of that gap. Same as the drawing.

treeline_gap_late.en: Maybe it'll have grown back by next time.

wreck_wait.en: Hang in there. Just one more trip.

wreck_broken.en: Follow the deer to someone who can fix it.

luggage.zh: 好，行李全摔出来了，都不用我翻了
在家唱得好好的，怎么一出来就哑了
luggage.en: It played fine at home. Why go quiet now

luggage.zh: 又是这个站，这名字我闭着眼都能写了
luggage.en: This station again. I could write it with my eyes closed

luggage.zh: 后面写什么呢，每次都卡在这儿
luggage.en: What comes next... I always get stuck here

wood_pickup.zh: 有这个了，你总该动一下了吧
wood_pickup.en: With this, you'll have to move, right

mat_scrap.zh: 飞机上掉的碎片，烧了也算用回去了
mat_scrap.en: It fell off the ship. Burning it is sort of giving it back

mat_resin.zh: 这树脂黏我一手，应该还挺好烧的
mat_resin.en: Resin all over my hands. Should burn nicely

fuel_full.en: That's enough. Let's try the ship

launch_fail.en: Couldn't you just say it all at once?

launch_fail.zh: 你这飞机掉下来以前就坏了
launch_fail.en: Your ship was broken before it fell

launch_fail.zh: 你从咱头顶过去，那动静，比打雷还难听
launch_fail.en: You went right over me. Sounded worse than thunder

launch_fail.zh: 就是降落的时候偏了点
launch_fail.en: The landing was a little off, that's all

options.zh: 你知道哪里能修吗？
options.en: Know anywhere I can get it fixed?

options.zh: 我平时开得没这么差。
options.en: I'm not usually this bad a pilot.

options.zh: 刚才树林里的声音，你听见了吗？
options.en: Did you hear that sound in the woods?

ch1_pilot.zh: 咱倒是信，你问问树信不信
ch1_pilot.en: I believe you. Ask the trees if they do

ch1_sound.zh: 听见了，林子这么大，什么响动都有
ch1_sound.en: I heard. Big forest. All kinds of noises

launch_b.zh: 先把你这飞机修好吧，跟咱走，咱认识个会修的
launch_b.en: Let's get your ship fixed first. Come on, I know someone who fixes things

launch_b.zh: 帮我看看这张画，你认得上面这个吗？
launch_b.en: Can you look at this drawing? Do you know what this is?
That's an elephant. There's one down the old road
Wait, you know about elephants too?
That's an elephant. There's one down the old road

road_1.en: Water? You asked the right deer

road_1.zh: 前头往左，有条小溪，水甜。
road_1.en: Up ahead on the left. There's a creek. Sweet water.

road_1.zh: 旧路那头以前还有老大的脚印呢
road_1.en: There used to be huge footprints down the old road

road_1.zh: 旧路以前有很大的脚印。
road_1.en: There used to be huge footprints on the old road.

road_1.zh: 你见的那头大象，长什么样？
road_1.en: The elephant you saw. What did it look like?

road_1.zh: 大象从树边过去的时候，树枝都跟着晃
road_1.en: When it walks past the trees, the branches all sway
The deer saw the elephant with its own eyes.

road_1.zh: 鼻子很长，左边的耳朵会动，走过去的时候树枝都在晃。
road_1.en: Long nose. Left ear moves. The branches sway when it walks past.

stall_intro.en: They used to sell food here.

stall_intro.zh: 一下雨，大家就往这棚子底下挤
stall_intro.en: When it rained, everyone squeezed in under here

stall_intro.zh: 咱小时候也往里钻，角老勾着人家的布
stall_intro.en: I squeezed in too when I was little. My antlers kept snagging the canvas

stall_intro.zh: 卖什么来着……咱还真忘了
stall_intro.en: What was it... I really forget

stall_intro.zh: 反正好吃，咱吃过的，这个可不骗你
stall_intro.en: It was good, though. I ate it. That part I'm not making up

stall_intro.zh: 说不定大象以前也从这儿走过呢
stall_intro.en: Maybe the elephant walked by here once too

stall_intro.zh: 页角：一只顶着棚布的鹿。
stall_intro.en: In the corner of the page: a deer with an awning on its head.

stall_intro.zh: 给那只鹿添了一对过大的角。
stall_intro.en: Gave the deer a pair of oversized antlers.

stall_look.en: The stall's still standing, at least

stall_look.zh: 我们那儿的车站，下雨的时候也这么挤
stall_look.en: Our station back home got this crowded in the rain too

stall_look.zh: 我都躲到最里头了，还是能淋一身
stall_look.en: I'd stand all the way at the back and still get soaked

stall_default.zh: 这东西放在棚子里也用不上，先带着吧
stall_default.en: No use for this at the stall. I'll hang on to it

deer_chat_stall.zh: 前头那棵歪树，打雷劈过。
deer_chat_stall.en: That crooked tree up ahead got hit by lightning.

deer_chat_stall.zh: 咱那天还在那棵树底下躲雨呢
deer_chat_stall.en: I was hiding under it from the rain that day
Is the elephant up ahead too?

deer_chat_stall.zh: 往前找找吧，兴许就碰上了
deer_chat_stall.en: Keep looking. Maybe we'll run into it

road_house_look.zh: 这么小的屋子，住着倒省事
road_house_look.en: A house this small must be easy to keep

road_house_look.zh: 窗台这块颜色浅些，以前放过什么吧？
road_house_look.en: This patch on the sill is lighter. Something used to sit here?

road_house_default.zh: 这东西在屋里也用不上，先收着吧
road_house_default.en: No use for this in here. I'll keep it

log_intro.en: This way's shorter. We'll go through here
How long since anyone walked this road?

log_intro.zh: 底下那几根你帮咱拖一下，挑轻的就行
log_intro.en: Help me drag the ones underneath. Just the light ones

log_intro.zh: 问起旧路，鹿忙着让我搬树枝，回头再问。
log_intro.en: Asked about the old road. The deer got busy making me move branches. Ask again later.

log_heavy.zh: 这根太重了，先拖底下的树枝吧
log_heavy.en: Too heavy. I'll drag the branches underneath first

deer_chat_log.zh: 从底下走，树皮滑，摔了咱可接不住你
deer_chat_log.en: Go under. The bark's slippery. If you fall, I can't catch you
Did the elephant come through here too?

branches_done.en: Can you carry that? Make two trips

branches_done.zh: 拿得动，你顾好你那边就行
branches_done.en: I've got it. You worry about your end

log_push.zh: 你见到大象的时候，离多近啊？
log_push.en: When you saw the elephant, how close were you?

log_push.zh: 隔得远，咱站的地方也不太好
log_push.en: Pretty far. And I wasn't standing in a good spot
The deer says: it was too far away.

fog_intro.zh: 这边走，水声最响那块底下是空的，咱掉下去过
fog_intro.en: This way. Where the water's loudest, the ground's hollow. I fell in once

fog_call.zh: 右边有敲树的声音，应该是鹿吧
fog_call.en: Something's knocking on a tree to the right. Must be the deer

went_wrong_first.zh: 雾里跟错了一次。先听，再走。
went_wrong_first.en: Took a wrong turn in the fog once. Listen first, then walk.

lines.en: No sun in the third car today

fog_wood_light.zh: 蹄印往前去了，再照远一点看看
fog_wood_light.en: The hoofprints keep going. Let me light up further ahead
There's a strip of cloth on that branch.

fog_default.zh: 还是得找个能照亮的东西
fog_default.en: I need something to light the way

hollow_edge.en: Wait. The ground drops away ahead

hollow_edge_plank.zh: 背包那块木板应该够长，搭上去试试
hollow_edge_plank.en: The plank in my bag should be long enough. Let's try it

hollow_look.zh: 这底下还有水，踩空就麻烦了
hollow_look.en: There's water down there. One wrong step and I'm in trouble

hollow_look.zh: 得找个东西搭过去才行
hollow_look.en: I need something to bridge it

hollow_default.zh: 拿这个搭桥够呛，再找找吧
hollow_default.en: That won't make a bridge. Keep looking

plank_bridge.en: It holds. Should be fine if I go slowly

treehouse_outside.zh: 你当时看清大象的样子了吗？
treehouse_outside.en: Did you get a good look at the elephant?

treehouse_outside.zh: 就一个背影，咱也没看清
treehouse_outside.en: Just its back. I couldn't really see

treehouse_outside.zh: 鹿说：只看到了背影。
treehouse_outside.en: The deer says: only saw it from behind.

treehouse_outside.zh: 鼻子都说得出来，怎么又只见过背影？
treehouse_outside.en: The deer knew about the nose, but only saw it from behind?

treehouse_outside.zh: 喂，你又跟谁吹自己见过大象了？
treehouse_outside.en: Hey. Who are you bragging to about the elephant this time?

treehouse_outside.zh: 隔着窗都听见你了，嗓门还挺大
treehouse_outside.en: I can hear you through the window. Loud, aren't you

treehouse_outside.zh: 咱这回是带人来修东西的
treehouse_outside.en: This time I brought someone with something to fix

treehouse_outside.zh: 请问……能修飞机吗？
treehouse_outside.en: Excuse me... can you fix a ship?

treehouse_outside.zh: 不能。
treehouse_outside.en: No.

treehouse_outside.zh: 喂，坏的零件呢，拿过来看看
treehouse_outside.en: Hey, where's the broken part? Let me see it

treehouse_outside.zh: 你站门口看着我干什么，零件拿来啊
treehouse_outside.en: Why are you just standing in the door? Bring the part

treehouse_outside.zh: 你往飞机里加的什么啊？
treehouse_outside.en: What did you put in this ship?

treehouse_outside.zh: 燃料。
treehouse_outside.en: Fuel.

treehouse_outside.zh: 谢谢啊，我还以为你给它喂了午饭呢
treehouse_outside.en: Thanks. I thought maybe you fed it lunch

treehouse_outside.zh: 我问你加的哪种燃料
treehouse_outside.en: I mean what kind of fuel

treehouse_outside.zh: 便宜的
treehouse_outside.en: The cheap kind

treehouse_outside.zh: 哈？就为了省这点钱，你敢开着这飞机飞那么远？
treehouse_outside.en: Huh? You flew this thing all that way to save a few coins?

treehouse_outside.zh: 真有你的。
treehouse_outside.en: You're something else.

treehouse_outside.zh: 卖的时候那人拍着胸口说能用，我就买了
treehouse_outside.en: The seller swore it was fine, so I bought it

treehouse_outside.zh: 那你让卖燃料的坐上来，带他飞一圈啊
treehouse_outside.en: Then put the seller in and take him for a spin

treehouse_outside.zh: 副驾驶不算，让他坐推进器上试试
treehouse_outside.en: Not the passenger seat. Strap him to the thruster

treehouse_outside.zh: 还笑呢，等飞机飞得起来再笑吧
treehouse_outside.en: Laughing? Save it for when it flies

treehouse_outside.zh: 过来啊，站那么远，怕我把你也拆了？
treehouse_outside.en: Come here. Why so far? Afraid I'll take you apart too?

treehouse_outside.zh: 架上这些都修好了吧，怎么没人来拿？
treehouse_outside.en: All this on the shelves is fixed, right? Why hasn't anyone picked it up?

treehouse_outside.zh: 东西的主人都搬走了
treehouse_outside.en: The owners all moved away

treehouse_outside.zh: 都搬走了？
treehouse_outside.en: All of them?

treehouse_outside.zh: 差不多。
treehouse_outside.en: More or less.

treehouse_outside.zh: 那这些东西你还一直留着？
treehouse_outside.en: And you've kept all of it?

treehouse_outside.zh: 都修好了，扔了多浪费，你倒舍得
treehouse_outside.en: It all works. Throwing it out would be a waste. You'd do that?

treehouse_outside.zh: 坐啊，哎那把放着，坐你面前这把！
treehouse_outside.en: Sit. No, not that one. The one in front of you!

treehouse_outside.zh: 喝点水？
treehouse_outside.en: Some water?

treehouse_outside.zh: 我不太爱甜的。
treehouse_outside.en: I don't really like sweet things.

treehouse_outside.zh: 那先放着呗，你要求还挺多
treehouse_outside.en: Then leave it. Picky, aren't you

treehouse_outside.zh: 喝这杯，没放糖，再挑你就渴着吧
treehouse_outside.en: Drink this one. No sugar. Complain again and you can stay thirsty

treehouse_outside.zh: 「别拿去装螺丝。」
treehouse_outside.en: "Not for screws."

treehouse_outside.zh: 杯底贴着纸条：别拿去装螺丝。旁边画了一个歪歪的生气脸。
treehouse_outside.en: A note stuck to the bottom of the cup: Not for screws. Next to it, a lopsided angry face.

treehouse_outside.zh: 杯子有什么好看的，你还走不走了？
treehouse_outside.en: What's so interesting about a cup? Are we doing this or not?

treehouse_outside.zh: 想飞起来还差三样东西，你听好啊
treehouse_outside.en: To fly, you still need three things. Listen up

treehouse_outside.zh: 松脂，拿来堵漏
treehouse_outside.en: Sap, to plug the leak

treehouse_outside.zh: 再找根弹簧，还有阀门零件，记住没？
treehouse_outside.en: Then a spring, and a valve part. Got that?

treehouse_outside.zh: 去哪里找？
treehouse_outside.en: Where do I find them?

treehouse_outside.zh: 问门口那只鹿呗，带路的事它最来劲
treehouse_outside.en: Ask the deer outside. Nothing it loves more than showing the way

treehouse_outside.zh: 这罐子拿好，装松脂用，别蹭得到处都是
treehouse_outside.en: Take this jar for the sap. Don't smear it everywhere

treehouse_outside.zh: 修推进器要三样东西：松脂、弹簧、阀门零件。
treehouse_outside.en: Three things to fix the thruster: sap, a spring, a valve part.

door_miluo_out.zh: 弥洛出去了啊，那晚点再来
door_miluo_out.en: Milo's out. I'll come back later

miluo_b_plain.zh: 三样找齐再来，少一样都修不了
miluo_b_plain.en: Come back with all three. One short and I can't fix it

miluo_b_plain.zh: 罐子拿稳啊，洒了你自己洗
miluo_b_plain.en: Hold that jar steady. Spill it, you clean it

miluo_b_ret.zh: 那几件修好的东西，你送回去了？
miluo_b_ret.en: Those things I fixed. You took them back?

deer_hint.zh: 找东西啊，这你问咱就对了
deer_hint.en: Looking for something? You asked the right deer

deer_hint_sap.zh: 商店旁边那棵老松你瞧见没，松脂一直往外冒
deer_hint_sap.en: See the old pine by the shop? Sap keeps oozing out of it

deer_hint_spring.zh: 空屋窗台有个闹钟，停了好些年了
deer_hint_spring.en: There's a clock on the empty house's sill. Stopped years ago

deer_hint_spring.zh: 舍不得拆闹钟，就去空地那个信号箱看看
deer_hint_spring.en: If you'd rather not take the clock apart, try the signal box in the clearing

deer_hint_valve.zh: 塌陷口那头有个旧信号箱，去那儿找
deer_hint_valve.en: There's an old signal box past the sinkhole. Look there

deer_hint_plank.zh: 塌陷口得先搭块板子，可别一脚踩下去
deer_hint_plank.en: You'll need a board across the sinkhole. Don't step in it

deer_hint_plank.zh: 小吃棚的架子都烂了，能拆块木板下来
deer_hint_plank.en: The snack stall's shelves are rotten. You could pull a plank off

deer_hint_done.zh: 零件齐了就进去吧，咱可帮不上修东西的忙
deer_hint_done.en: Got everything? Go on in. I'm no help with fixing

parts_all_line.zh: 松脂、弹簧、阀门，齐了，回树屋吧
parts_all_line.en: Sap, spring, valve. That's everything. Back to the treehouse

plank_take.zh: 这块木板还挺结实，带上吧
plank_take.en: This plank's pretty solid. I'll take it

pine_look.zh: 松脂从这道口子里渗出来了
pine_look.en: Sap's seeping out of this cut
Better catch it before it all drips away

pine_default.en: I need a jar to catch it

pine_sap.zh: 装满了，拿稳点，可别洒一身
pine_sap.en: Full. Steady now, don't get it all over me

clock.zh: 这闹钟停了多久了，指针都不动了
clock.en: How long has this clock been stopped? The hands don't move at all

clock.zh: 闹钟里应该有能用的弹簧吧
clock.en: There should be a usable spring in there

clock.zh: 可人家回来，还得用这个吧
clock.en: But they'll need it when they come back

label.en: Leave a note, borrow the spring

clock_take.zh: 空屋窗台的闹钟里借了一根弹簧，留了字条。
clock_take.en: Borrowed a spring from the clock on the empty house's sill. Left a note.

clock_leave.zh: 先找找别的吧，也不急着拆人家闹钟
clock_leave.en: I'll look elsewhere first. No rush to take apart someone's clock

clock_after_note.en: My note's still under the clock

signal_box.en: This signal box has been dead a long time

signal_box.zh: 阀门还拧得动，可以拿下来
signal_box.en: The valve still turns. I can take it off

signal_spring.zh: 旁边还有一根备用的弹簧
signal_spring.en: There's a spare spring next to it

signal_box_after.zh: 信号箱里能用的都拿出来了
signal_box_after.en: I've taken everything useful from the signal box

radio_look.zh: 收音机上也有牌子，是谁送来修的啊？
radio_look.en: The radio has a tag too. Who brought it in?

radio_look.zh: 早修好了，在这儿放到现在也没人来听
radio_look.en: Fixed it ages ago. It's sat here ever since, and no one's come to listen

radio_look.zh: 我们那边的广播啊，来来回回就报那几个站名
radio_look.en: The radio back home just read the same few station names, over and over

label.en: Take it back to its owner

radio_ask.zh: 小吃棚顺路，我把收音机带回去？
radio_ask.en: The snack stall's on my way. Should I take the radio back?

radio_ask.zh: 拿吧，底下托着点，才修好的
radio_ask.en: Go ahead. Hold it from the bottom. I just fixed it

sign_look.en: Why does this signpost spin by itself?

sign_look.zh: 路标嘛，还没找着方向呢
sign_look.en: It's a signpost. It hasn't found its way yet

sign_look.zh: 让它转呗，你别伸手掰就行
sign_look.en: Let it spin. Just don't grab it

label.en: Take it back to its owner

sign_ask.zh: 路标我也带过去，放回空地那边？
sign_ask.en: I'll take the signpost too. Back to the clearing?

sign_ask.zh: 随你，哎你拿那头干什么，尖的，扎手
sign_ask.en: Suit yourself. Hey, not that end. It's pointy

lamp_look.zh: 灯芯换好了，就是没油了，想点得自己找
lamp_look.en: New wick. No oil, though. Want it lit, find your own

lamp_look.zh: 牌子上写着：路边的小屋

label.en: Take it back to its owner

lamp_ask.zh: 这盏灯我放回路边小屋的窗台上吧？
lamp_ask.en: Should I put this lamp back on the roadside hut's sill?

lamp_ask.zh: 行，走路看着点，灯罩薄，磕一下就碎了
lamp_ask.en: Fine. Watch your step. The glass is thin. One bump and it's gone

radio_return.zh: 收音机怎么全是沙沙声啊
雨棚下面压着一张纸条
radio_return.en: There's a note tucked under the awning

radio_return.zh: 纸条这半边泡花了，字都认不出来
radio_return.en: The rain's smeared this half. I can't read it

radio_return.zh: 小吃棚的雨棚下压着一张纸条：收摊了，往云那边走。
radio_return.en: A note under the snack stall's awning: Closed up. Heading for the clouds.

lamp_return.zh: 油灯先摆回窗台吧，油以后再添
lamp_return.en: Lamp back on the sill. Oil can come later

lamp_return.zh: 门框上这些线，是用来量身高的吧？
lamp_return.en: These lines on the doorframe... for measuring height?

lamp_return.zh: 最高这道边上，还刻了朵小云
lamp_return.en: There's a little cloud carved by the highest one

lamp_return.zh: 路边小屋的门框上刻着身高线。最后一道旁边，刻着一朵云。
lamp_return.en: Height marks on the roadside hut's doorframe. Next to the last one, a carved cloud.

sign_return.zh: 底座旁边，压着半张车票
sign_return.en: Half a ticket, tucked by the base

sign_return.zh: 车票终点都泡花了，这可怎么找
sign_return.en: The destination's washed out. No way to know where they went

sign_return.zh: 路标归位，朝着云那边。底座旁有半张车票，终点泡花了。
sign_return.en: Signpost back in place, facing the clouds. Half a ticket by the base, the destination washed out.

road_house_after.zh: 这朵云刻得浅，差点漏看
road_house_after.en: The cloud's carved so faintly I almost missed it

sign_base_default.zh: 底座塞不下这个，换一个试试
sign_base_default.en: That won't fit. Try something else

sign_base_after.en: The signpost still points at the clouds

glade_rock.en: Looks like a kid did it

glade_rock.zh: 刻痕都磨平了，应该有些年头了吧
glade_rock.en: The lines are worn smooth. It must be old

label.zh: 很久以前，就有人见过它
画得跟小孩画的一样，也许谁都没见过
label.en: Drawn like a kid's picture. Maybe no one ever saw it

label.zh: 岩石上刻着长鼻子、四条腿，看着挺旧的
label.en: A long nose and four legs carved in rock. Looks old

el4_believe.zh: 很久以前，就有人见过它。

el4_doubt.zh: 画得跟小孩画的一样，也许谁都没见过
el4_doubt.en: Drawn like a kid's picture. Maybe no one ever saw it

el4_fact.zh: 岩石上刻着长鼻子、四条腿，看着挺旧的
el4_fact.en: A long nose and four legs carved in rock. Looks old

glade_rock_again.zh: 刻这幅画的人，当时也站在这儿吧
glade_rock_again.en: Whoever carved this must have stood right here

toolwall.zh: 工具的轮廓描了两排，怎么差这么高？
toolwall.en: Two rows of tool outlines. Why so far apart?

toolwall.zh: 下面那排工具都拿走了啊

toolwall.en: "Put them back when you're done. I can't reach"

coat_chair.zh: 刚才弥洛不让我坐的，就是这把吧
coat_chair.en: This must be the chair Milo wouldn't let me sit in

coat_chair.zh: 外套褪色褪成这样，还搭在椅背上呢
coat_chair.en: The coat's this faded, and it's still draped over the back

cups_note.zh: 这张生气脸，画得还挺像
cups_note.en: The angry face is a pretty good likeness

part_pack.zh: 这包新零件拆开过了吧
part_pack.en: This new part's been unwrapped before

part_pack.zh: 包装纸都折软了，又给包回去了
part_pack.en: The paper's gone soft from folding. Wrapped back up again

part_pack.zh: 旧零件补了这么多回，还接着用啊
part_pack.en: The old part's been patched so many times, and it's still in use

postcard_look.zh: 玻璃下面压着半张明信片
postcard_look.en: Half a postcard, pressed under the glass

stove_resin.zh: 树脂就放一小块，试试嘛
stove_resin.en: Just a little resin. Let's see

stove_resin.zh: 喂，你怎么往我炉子里乱塞东西！
stove_resin.en: Hey! Don't just shove things in my stove!

stove_resin.zh: 算了，还挺香的，就这一块啊
stove_resin.en: Fine. It smells nice. Just the one

stove_default.zh: 这东西收好吧，放炉子里该烧坏了
stove_default.en: Better keep this. It'd burn up in there

radio_b.zh: 收音机的名牌都落灰了，字盖住一半
radio_b.en: The radio's name tag is dusty. Half the writing's covered
Leave it. I'll wipe it later

sign_b.zh: 让它转呗，又没挡你的路
sign_b.en: Let it spin. It's not in your way

dish.en: The dish is full of screws

dish.zh: 这些螺丝我挑过了，都能用，你别给我丢了
dish.en: I sorted those. They all work. Don't lose any

kettle_a.zh: 以前早上赶车，哪有空等水烧开啊
kettle_a.en: Back when I rushed for the train every morning, who had time to wait for a kettle

kettle_b.zh: 架子上还是摆着两个杯子
kettle_b.en: Still two cups on the shelf

kettle_b.zh: 杯子顺手拿的，你还数上了？
kettle_b.en: I just grabbed some cups. You're counting now?

gramophone_a.zh: 留声机先别碰，放着放着就卡了
gramophone_a.en: Don't touch that. It sticks partway through

gramophone_b.en: It finally played all the way through
Why is this song so slow

box_a.en: There's a box on the table

box_a.zh: 盒子放着吧，你要的东西不在里面
box_a.en: Leave the box. What you need isn't in there

box_b.zh: 盒子看够了？把盖子合上吧

pipes_a.en: The pipes in the wall keep making noise

pipes_a.zh: 管道响我听见了，先修你那飞机，急什么
pipes_a.en: I hear them. Your ship first. What's the hurry

pipes_b.zh: 拧反了两次，你还挺得意
pipes_b.en: Turned it the wrong way twice, and look how proud you are

miluo_chat_bye.en: Still here? The door's on the left

miluo_chat_bye.zh: 燃料买好点的啊，省那点钱干什么
miluo_chat_bye.en: Buy better fuel. Why scrimp on that

parts_return.zh: 还挺快嘛，零件摊开，我看看
parts_return.en: That was quick. Lay the parts out, let me see

parts_return.zh: 我也帮点忙吧，总不能光坐着看
parts_return.en: Let me help. I can't just sit and watch
Second from the left. Hand it over

tool_wrong_a.zh: 这才第一把，要我帮你数啊？
tool_wrong_a.en: That's the first one. Want me to count for you?

tool_wrong_c.zh: 拿错了！那么大一把，你看能伸进去吗？
tool_wrong_c.en: Wrong one! That huge thing? Think it'll fit in there?

tool_right.zh: 我就看过说明书，图上画得挺简单的啊
tool_right.en: I read the manual. The pictures made it look easy

tool_right.zh: 那就看我这边，窗户上又没写说明书
tool_right.en: Then look over here. The manual's not on the window

tool_right.zh: 不会你就问，弄坏了我真要骂你了啊
tool_right.en: If you don't know, ask. Break it and I really will yell at you

pipes_intro.zh: 你闭着眼也听得出来啊？
pipes_intro.en: You can tell with your eyes closed?

pipes_intro.zh: 你先睁着眼行不行，手都拧反了
pipes_intro.en: How about you keep yours open? You're turning it backwards

pipe_a.zh: 这段听着挺脆，像敲空瓶子
pipe_a.en: This one sounds crisp. Like tapping an empty bottle

pipe_b.zh: 闷闷的，像隔着一层被子
这段就是积灰了，接着听下一段
pipe_b.en: That one's just dusty. Try the next

pipe_c.zh: 这儿有点尖响，应该就是这段了吧？
pipe_c.en: A thin, sharp hiss. This must be the one?

pipe_c.zh: 再听错我真要怀疑你耳朵了
pipe_c.en: One more wrong guess and I'd start worrying about your ears

pipe_c.zh: 右边那段管道，细小的尖响。
pipe_c.en: Right pipe: a thin, sharp hiss.

pipe_c.zh: 那当然，我在旁边盯了你多久啊
pipe_c.en: Of course. I watched you the whole time

pipe_c.zh: 知道了，下回我教你的时候，你先让我说完
pipe_c.en: Yeah, yeah. Next time I'm teaching you, let me finish first

pipe_c.zh: 装回飞机的时候，照着刚才的顺序来。
pipe_c.en: When you put it back in the ship, do it in the same order.

pipe_c.zh: 管道装好了。右边那段漏气，听着有细细的尖声。
pipe_c.en: Pipes done. The right one was leaking. You could hear a thin hiss.

gramophone.zh: 我的音乐盒也老卡在一半
gramophone.en: My music box always gets stuck halfway too

gramophone.zh: 你的音乐盒啊，下次少拍两下吧
gramophone.en: Your music box. Hit it less next time

gramophone.zh: 它都卡住了，你拍它也唱不出来啊
gramophone.en: It's stuck. Smacking it won't make it sing
Why is the gramophone still stuck?
Then why not swap it in?

gramophone.zh: 换上新的，声音就不一样了
gramophone.en: With a new one, it won't sound the same

options.zh: 我还以为能响了就算修好了
options.en: I thought if it made sound, it was fixed

options.zh: 那就先放着吧
options.en: Then leave it for now

options.zh: 我的音乐盒，谢谢你
options.en: Thank you. For my music box

ch2_fixed.zh: 会响就算修好？你飞机摔下来的时候也挺响啊
ch2_fixed.en: If it makes sound, it's fixed? Your ship made plenty of sound coming down

ch2_leave.zh: 我想什么时候修就什么时候修呗
ch2_leave.en: I'll fix it whenever I feel like it

ch2_thanks.en: It was nothing. Just hold on to it

gramophone_b2.zh: 拿稳你的音乐盒啊，再摔坏我可不管了
gramophone_b2.en: Hold on to that music box. Break it again and you're on your own

pump_out.zh: 起来吧，还得出去送趟水泵
pump_out.en: Up you get. We've got a water pump to deliver
You carry the pump. Don't drop it
See? I told you she could fix it

pump_out.zh: 少来，每次给我领一堆麻烦回来，你都这么说
pump_out.en: Please. You say that every time you bring me trouble

empty_house.zh: 这屋上回咱来就空着了
empty_house.en: This place was empty last time I came too

empty_house.zh: 我知道啊，你都说几遍了
empty_house.en: I know. You've said so a hundred times

empty_note.en: The note on the windowsill. Yours?

empty_note.zh: 字条留着吧，人家回来总得知道谁拿的
empty_note.en: Leave it there. When they're back, they'll want to know who took it

door_dust.zh: 门槛上积了这么厚的灰
door_dust.en: So much dust on the doorstep

empty_item.zh: 门边这个包裹，放多久了？
empty_item.en: How long has this parcel been by the door?

empty_item.zh: 包裹这绳结倒挺紧，像最近重新系过
empty_item.en: But the knot's tight. Like someone retied it recently

deer_chat_empty.zh: 这门口一下雨就积水，咱绕着走
deer_chat_empty.en: This doorway floods when it rains. I go around

miluo_chat_empty.en: Let's go. Keep looking and it'll be dark

shop.zh: 这家的饼甜得要命，我吃一次就够了
shop.en: Their cakes are sickly sweet. Once was enough
I remember you used to come every day

shop.zh: 你连我吃几回饼都记着啊？
shop.en: You keep count of how many cakes I eat?

shop.zh: 弥洛以前跟她那朋友来，每回都——
shop.en: Milo used to come with her friend, and every time...

shop.zh: 有空看我，你先把角上那块破布摘了吧
shop.en: If you've got time to watch me, take that rag off your antlers

shop.zh: 这块泥滑，咱摔过，脚下当心点
shop.en: This mud's slippery. I fell here once. Watch your step

shop.zh: 那家养过只鸟，见着咱就啄
shop.en: That house had a bird. It pecked me every time
Let's go round the back. It's shorter

shop.zh: 鹿说：那块泥容易打滑；那户人家养过很凶的鸟；从后头绕更快。
shop.en: The deer says: the mud there is slippery; that house had a mean bird; round the back is faster.

shop.zh: 总叫你鹿，日记上也这么写吗？
shop.en: I keep calling you Deer. Is that what I write in my journal too?

shop.zh: 就叫咱鹿呗，这里又没第二个
shop.en: Just call me Deer. There's no other one here

shop.zh: 页角那只大角鹿旁边，补上名字：鹿。
shop.en: Added a name next to the big-antlered deer in the corner: Deer.

shop.zh: 角还能画大点，咱的哪有这么小
shop.en: You can draw the antlers bigger. Mine aren't that small

shop_window.zh: 玻璃后面有一只空点心罐
shop_window.en: An empty cookie jar behind the glass
"She says they're awful, but save them anyway"

shop_window_b.zh: 玻璃后面有一只空点心罐
shop_window_b.en: An empty cookie jar behind the glass

shop_photo.zh: 这合影只剩半张，雨都泡皱了
shop_photo.en: Only half the photo's left, and the rain's wrinkled it

shop_photo.zh: 照片里那只手在给弥洛扣纸帽啊
shop_photo.en: The hand in the photo is putting a paper hat on Milo

miluo_home.en: The deer's waiting for you on the slope

miluo_home.zh: 看完回来一趟啊，还有东西给你
miluo_home.en: Come back after. I've got something for you

slope_truth.zh: 你当时是在这儿哪个位置看见大象的？
slope_truth.en: So where were you standing when you saw the elephant?
There's something I have to tell you

slope_truth.zh: 大象，咱其实没亲眼见过
slope_truth.en: I never actually saw the elephant

slope_truth.zh: 小时候，咱娘带咱走过这儿
slope_truth.en: When I was little, my ma brought me through here

slope_truth.zh: 咱娘指着雾里，说那边有大象
slope_truth.en: Ma pointed into the fog and said there was an elephant out there

slope_truth.zh: 咱个子矮，看不清，就记得咱娘站了好久
slope_truth.en: I was too short to see. I just remember Ma standing there a long time

slope_truth.zh: 往后带人，咱还是走这条路
slope_truth.en: After that, whenever I showed someone the way, I still came this way

slope_truth.zh: 说得多了，就说成是咱亲眼见过了
slope_truth.en: I told it so many times, it turned into me seeing it myself

slope_truth.zh: 鼻子很长，左边的耳朵会动，走过去的时候树枝都在晃
slope_truth.en: Long nose. Left ear moves. The branches sway when it walks past
You made all that up too?

slope_truth.zh: 有些是听来的，有些咱也记混了
slope_truth.en: Some of it I heard. Some I got mixed up
Do you know what it took for me to get here...

slope_truth.zh: 咱怕说没见过，你就不肯跟咱来了
slope_truth.en: I was scared if I said I hadn't seen it, you wouldn't come with me

narr.zh: 我得顺着你说，你才肯听，对吗？
narr.en: So I have to tell you what you want to hear, or you won't listen. Right?

options.zh: 你可以带错路，但别骗我
options.en: You can get the way wrong. Just don't lie to me

options.zh: 我刚才真的很高兴
options.en: I was really happy, back there

options.zh: 以后不知道，就说不知道
options.en: Next time you don't know, just say so

ch3_lie.zh: 路咱认得，大象的事是咱瞎说了
ch3_lie.en: The way, I know. The elephant part, I made up

ch3_glad.zh: 咱看见了，你连日记都拿出来了
ch3_glad.en: I saw. You even got your journal out

ch3_dontknow.zh: 该早点告诉你的，是咱嘴硬
ch3_dontknow.en: I should've told you sooner. I was being stubborn

slope_b.zh: 凹陷：最靠近坡边的那处被雨冲过，另外几处能看出连续的落点。
slope_b.en: Hollows: the one nearest the edge is washed out by rain. The others look like a trail of footfalls.

slope_b.zh: 就这块凹下去的，咱前几天来还没这么深
slope_b.en: This one here. It wasn't this deep a few days ago

lines.zh: 我得顺着你说，你才肯听，对吗？
lines.en: So I have to tell you what you want to hear, or you won't listen. Right?

slope_b.en: Don't know what it is yet

slope_b.zh: 低鸣从坡地东边的雾里来，只响了一声。
slope_b.en: The low rumble came from the fog east of the slope. Just once.

slope_b.zh: 最近那处又量了一次：长四步，宽三步半。
slope_b.en: Measured the newest one again: four steps long, three and a half wide.

hollows_again.zh: 这些凹坑的样子都画下来了
先记着吧，以后有线索了还能翻出来对对
hollows_again.en: I'll keep them. If something turns up, I can check back

deer_chat_slope.zh: 大象的事，我想自己再找找看
deer_chat_slope.en: The elephant... I want to keep looking on my own
Let's go back. Milo'll be getting impatient

deer_chat_slope.zh: 她要嫌咱慢，你听听就行
deer_chat_slope.en: If she grumbles that we're slow, just let it go

revisit.zh: 留声机那个旧零件，实在用不了了
revisit.en: That old part in the gramophone. It was past using

revisit.zh: 看什么，坏成那样，本来就该换了
revisit.en: What? It was that broken. It needed replacing anyway

revisit.zh: 这首曲子慢死了
revisit.en: This song is painfully slow

revisit.zh: 以前不是这个速度吗？
revisit.en: Wasn't it always this speed?

revisit.zh: 我那朋友嫌慢，非得自己调快
revisit.en: My friend thought it was too slow. Insisted on speeding it up

revisit.zh: 调坏了还不认，说是我听不懂
revisit.en: Broke it, wouldn't admit it. Said I just didn't get it

revisit.zh: 笑什么，你又没听过她唱
revisit.en: What's funny? You never heard her sing

revisit.zh: 她一唱起来，比留声机还快
revisit.en: When she sang, she was faster than the gramophone

revisit.zh: 你那朋友后来去哪儿了？
revisit.en: Where did your friend go?

revisit.zh: 不知道
revisit.en: No idea

revisit.zh: 只知道去过河流城市
revisit.en: Only that she went through the river city

revisit.zh: 再往后，我就没消息了
revisit.en: After that, I heard nothing

revisit.zh: 她走之前应该跟你说过吧？
revisit.en: She must have told you before she left

revisit.zh: 说了
revisit.en: She did

revisit.zh: 那你……
revisit.en: Then you...

revisit.zh: 那会儿正吵架呢，我哪听得进去啊
revisit.en: We were in the middle of a fight. I wasn't listening

revisit.zh: 她收东西，我就说想走就走呗
revisit.en: She was packing, and I said, go if you want

revisit.zh: 都到门口了还磨蹭，我又说了一遍
revisit.en: She dawdled at the door, so I said it again

revisit.zh: 我就是气不过啊
revisit.en: I was just so angry

revisit.zh: 这儿好好的东西还多着呢
revisit.en: There's plenty of good stuff right here

revisit.zh: 她说走就走，倒像是我非赖在这儿一样
revisit.en: She just up and left. Like I was the one clinging to this place

revisit.zh: 以前迟到十分钟都得跟我解释半天
revisit.en: She used to explain for ages if she was ten minutes late

revisit.zh: 这回可省事了，连借口都懒得找
revisit.en: This time she made it easy. Didn't even bother with an excuse

revisit.zh: 那个人的号码，你还留着吗？
revisit.en: Do you still have her number?

narr.zh: 发送失败　发送失败　发送失败
narr.en: Failed to send  Failed to send  Failed to send

revisit.zh: 换过号码了。
revisit.en: She changed numbers.

revisit.zh: 她走的时候说，安顿下来再给我新的。
revisit.en: When she left, she said she'd send the new one once she was settled.

revisit.zh: 要是哪天真收到她的消息呢？
revisit.en: What if you hear from her someday?

revisit.zh: 收到再说呗，谁知道到时候还想不想回。
revisit.en: I'll worry about it then. Who knows if I'll even want to reply.

revisit.zh: 你要去河流城市吧，把这包种子带上
revisit.en: You're going to the river city, right? Take this seed with you

revisit.zh: 要我替你种在哪儿？
revisit.en: Where do you want me to plant it?

revisit.zh: 你想种就种呗
revisit.en: Plant it wherever you like

revisit.zh: 别埋太深啊，先浇一点水
revisit.en: Don't bury it too deep. Water it a little first

revisit.zh: 还有，别隔两天就挖出来看看长没长
revisit.en: And don't dig it up every other day to check

revisit.zh: 等种子自己冒头呗，你盯着也长不快啊
revisit.en: Let it come up on its own. Staring won't make it grow faster

revisit.zh: 你以前也挖出来看过吧？
revisit.en: You used to dig yours up to check, didn't you?

revisit.zh: 你管我！教你种东西呢，你就听见这句？
revisit.en: Mind your own business! I'm teaching you to plant, and that's what you heard?

revisit.zh: 好，我记着，省得回头真种坏了
revisit.en: Okay, I'll write it down. So I don't kill it

revisit.zh: 种子：别埋太深，先浇一点水。不许隔两天就挖出来看。
revisit.en: Seed: not too deep, water it a little first. No digging it up every other day to check.

revisit.zh: 这也记啊，你本子够写吗？
revisit.en: You're writing that down too? Got enough pages?

revisit.zh: 河流城市的地址，能抄一份吗？
revisit.en: Can I copy down the address in the river city?

revisit.zh: 地址上的字是潦草了点，不认识就问我
revisit.en: The handwriting's messy. Ask if you can't read it

revisit.zh: 别抄错了又来怪我啊
revisit.en: And don't copy it wrong and blame me

farewell_all.zh: 那三件东西，你全送回原来的地方了？
farewell_all.en: Those three things. You took them all back?

farewell_all.zh: 嗯，路标放回去就不转了，指着云那边
farewell_all.en: Yeah. Once the signpost was back, it stopped spinning. It points at the clouds

farewell_all.zh: 我知道路标指哪边，修的时候就知道了
farewell_all.en: I know where it points. Knew it when I fixed it

farewell_some.en: The deer says you've been returning things?

farewell.zh: 种子长出来，我就回来告诉你
farewell.en: When the seed sprouts, I'll come back and tell you

farewell.zh: 说好了啊，别随便拔棵草回来就说是种出来的
farewell.en: Deal. But don't pull up some weed and tell me you grew it

farewell.zh: 我给的种子长什么样，我认得
farewell.en: I know what my seed grows into

farewell.zh: 也就我肯帮你收拾这些了
farewell.en: Nobody else would clean up after you like this

farewell.zh: 砸倒一片树林，还得给你修飞机
farewell.en: You flatten half a forest, and I still fix your ship

farewell.zh: 没长出来也可以回来啊，又没说一定得长出来
farewell.en: You can come back even if it doesn't sprout. Nobody said it had to
If the joint starts making noise again, message here.

farewell.zh: 把哪边响、什么时候响写清楚，别一上来就喊救命。
farewell.en: Say which side and when. Don't just open with "help."

farewell.zh: 修理。省得你把它当许愿箱。
farewell.en: Repairs. So you don't treat it like a wishing well.

farewell.zh: 也给咱留个位置，咱有事就来这儿找她发。
farewell.en: Save a spot for me too. If I need something, I'll come get her to send it.

farewell.zh: 你先把蹄子擦干净再进来。
farewell.en: Wipe your hooves before you come in.

go_home.zh: 改正：长鼻子、左耳会动、树枝晃，都是鹿听来的。
go_home.en: Correction: the long nose, the moving left ear, the swaying branches. The deer only heard about them.

go_home.zh: 这咱不知道，咱就认得森林里这几条路
go_home.en: That I don't know. I only know the paths in this forest

go_home.zh: 下次你再来，旧路可能又变样了
go_home.en: Next time you come, the old road might look different again

go_home.zh: 到路口喊咱就行，咱带你走
go_home.en: Just call for me at the turnoff. I'll take you
Okay. This time I'll remember the way too

go_home.zh: 旧路路口：下次先到这儿找鹿。
go_home.en: Turnoff to the old road: next time, find the deer here first.

deer_chat_bye.zh: 云底下咱没去过，你自己当心点啊
deer_chat_bye.en: I've never been under the clouds. Take care of yourself
Then I'll tell you about it when I'm back

launch_go.zh: 云底下到底什么样，还是得自己去看看
launch_go.en: Whatever's under the clouds, I'll have to see for myself

tell_radio.zh: 小吃棚的雨棚底下压着张字条，说收摊了，往云那边走。
tell_radio.en: There was a note under the snack stall's awning. It said they'd closed up and headed for the clouds.

tell_lamp.zh: 小屋门框上有量身高的线，最高那道旁边刻了朵云。
tell_lamp.en: The hut's doorframe has height marks. There's a cloud carved by the highest one.

tell_sign.zh: 路标放回底座就停了，指着云那边。旁边压着半张车票。
tell_sign.en: Once the signpost was on its base, it stopped. It points at the clouds. There was half a ticket beside it.

tell_end.zh: 送回去了就行，看我干什么
tell_end.en: You took them back. That's enough. Why are you looking at me

c1_crash.zh: 你是谁？你为什么制造出了这么大的噪音？
c1_crash.en: Who are you? Why did you make such a racket?

options.zh: 我是你的母亲，还不过来孝敬我
options.en: I'm your mother. Come and pay your respects.

options.zh: 我也不知道我是谁，帮帮我
options.en: I don't know who I am either. Help me.

c1_child.zh: 那你就当咱的孩子吧。这个给你。
c1_child.en: Then you can be my child. This is for you.

options.zh: 孩子，把你的背包给我，我需要一个背包
options.en: Child, give me your backpack. I need a backpack.

options.zh: 妈妈，你有没有见过一个背包？
options.en: Mom, have you seen a backpack?

c1_ask_bag.zh: 鹿怎么会需要背包啊，我没有背包的说……
c1_ask_bag.en: Why would a deer need a backpack? I don't have one...

c1_ask_bag.zh: 不过……我刚刚在那边看到了一个，要不你跟我过来看看……
c1_ask_bag.en: But... I just saw one over there. Want to come and look...

c1_wreck_look.zh: 你貌似是从这个焦黑的残骸之中掉出来的
c1_wreck_look.en: Looks like you fell out of this charred wreck

c1_got_bag.en: Press Tab to open the backpack

c1_drawing.en: I want... to find the elephant

c1_woke.zh: 你可真行啊，就这样去欺骗小鹿。
c1_woke.en: Impressive. Lying to the little deer like that.

c1_woke.zh: 可怜的失忆者啊，你应该庆幸是小鹿找到的你。
c1_woke.en: Poor amnesiac. You should be glad it was the deer who found you.

options.zh: 我真的是她妈妈，她基因突变了
options.en: I really am her mom. She's a genetic mutation.

options.zh: 啊，我原来不是小鹿的女儿么
options.en: Wait, so I'm not the deer's daughter?

options.zh: 对不起，请你放过我，我找回了一点我的记忆
options.en: I'm sorry. Please let me go. I've got a bit of my memory back.

options.zh: 你能够告诉我发生了什么事情么，我找回了一点我的记忆
options.en: Can you tell me what happened? I've got a bit of my memory back.

c1_woke_b.zh: 你是从这个飞船来的，想必你应该也想要从这个飞船飞走吧
c1_woke_b.en: You came from that ship. I bet you want to fly off in it, too.

c1_woke_b.zh: 她说的没错，我想要修好这个飞船，我是……晨
c1_woke_b.en: She's right. I want to fix the ship. I am... Chen

c1_woke_b.zh: 那么……这样吧，把小鹿送给你的玩具给我，我就帮你修复飞船
c1_woke_b.en: Then... how about this. Give me the toy the deer gave you, and I'll fix your ship.

narr.zh: 爱与记忆越深沉的物品，燃烧值越高。
narr.en: The deeper the love and memory in a thing, the more it burns.

narr.zh: 给出去，就再也回不到你手里了。
narr.en: Once you give it away, it never comes back.

options.zh: 给你
options.en: Here.

options.zh: 不给
options.en: No.

c1_bear_give.zh: 开个玩笑的，这个东西对她很重要，我是不会烧掉它的。
c1_bear_give.en: Just kidding. That thing matters to her. I'd never burn it.

c1_bear_keep.zh: 开个玩笑的，这个东西对她很重要，我是不会烧掉它的。
c1_bear_keep.en: Just kidding. That thing matters to her. I'd never burn it.

options.zh: 为什么要玩弄我情感，你个老巫婆
options.en: Why toy with my feelings, you old witch?

options.zh: 求求你告诉我应该怎么办，我做什么都可以
options.en: Please, tell me what to do. I'll do anything.

c1_bear_b.zh: 去森林找永燃之木吧，我需要它才能有足够的燃料来帮你修复……
c1_bear_b.en: Go find the Everburning Wood in the forest. I need it for enough fuel to fix your ship...

c1_door_b.zh: 我可担心你了……给你的玩偶，你还留着对么……
c1_door_b.en: I was so worried... You still have the toy I gave you, right...

c1_door_b.zh: 我来带你去找永燃之木
c1_door_b.en: I'll take you to find the Everburning Wood

c1_fix._todo: 临时转折，等本2兔定稿：永燃之木为什么烧不起来

c1_photo.en: Plant it once you're under the clouds.

c1_bye_mom.en: Mom, come back and see me soon...

one_way.zh: 你的直觉告诉你，你应该往前探索。
one_way.en: Your instincts tell you to keep exploring ahead.
